verdict.rationale: Langfuse lists 'Data Retention Policies' as a feature, but for self-hosted deployments it is gated behind an Enterprise license key. Beyond that, the only data control evidenced is self-hosting the platform on your own infrastructure. The pack never describes how retention is configured and says nothing about deleting traces or user data. Missing for 10: documented retention configuration details, explicit trace/user data deletion capability (UI/API), availability of retention controls without an enterprise license, independent or hands-on corroboration.
